rule.scope: A literal is treated as a concatenation operand only when the character immediately before its opening quote or immediately after its closing quote is '+' in the bundle source. Standalone literals are never overridden.
rule.order: cache.json (per-entry validated) -> cache-extra.json -> curated fragment override for concatenation operands -> restore the literal's original leading/trailing spaces -> add the one separator space the glued English needs on the operand side.
rule.spacingConvention: Author-chosen exact spaces. Unit fragments attach to the number on their left and carry a trailing space only where another number follows: 天->'d ', 小时->'h ', 分钟->'min ', 秒->'s', 毫秒->'ms ', 时->':00'. This yields '3d 5h 2min 1s'. Suffix fragments that follow a number/word carry a leading space (' devices', ' blocked devices', ' APs'). Prefix fragments that precede a number/name carry a trailing space ('There are', 'Please enter ', 'Showing '). Counters: bare 台/个/款 collapse to a single space (number stays); compound counter+noun tokens become ' devices'/' APs'/etc.
rule.counters: 台 is never 'Taiwan' now: %d台AP -> '2 APs', %d台设备 -> '3 devices', %d台已禁设备 -> '3 blocked devices'.
rule.unavoidableSpacing: Automatic junction spacing adds a single ASCII space on the operand side only when the English boundary character is alphanumeric (or ) , ; :) and no space is already present; this changes 41 occurrences in business + 2 in sdk.
rule.notExpressible: Fragments whose English word order cannot be produced by literal substitution (e.g. the topology line that joins array items with the Chinese separator '和' inside T.join('和'), or numeric count labels that use Chinese punctuation outside the translated literal) are left at their cache translation; see unusedOverrideKeys for curated entries that did not apply and THEME notes in report.json.

dictionaryModule.justification: Pinyin -> Chinese character lookup tables consumed by code (e.g. key 'a' -> '阿啊呵腌', key 'yi' -> '一以已意议义...'), used for Chinese search/input; never displayed as UI text. Translating them would corrupt the search tables, so they are deliberately preserved. Verified byte-identical between original and patched sdk.bundle.

regexCharacterClasses.what: CJK-bearing \u escapes OUTSIDE string literals: JavaScript regex character classes

knownQualityRisks: Concatenation fragments are now handled by the curated fragment override map + automatic junction spacing (see fragmentOverrides section). The named cases now read: duration '3d 5h 2min 1s' (was '3Sky5Hour2Minute1Second'), '%d台已禁设备' -> '3 blocked devices' (was 'Have3Banned device'), '%d台AP' -> '2 APs' (was 'filter out2Taiwan AP').

Residual, non-CJK items left alone deliberately: (a) Chinese punctuation characters outside the CJK-ideograph ranges (、 U+3001, 。 U+3002, fullwidth parentheses/colons U+FF00 block) can still appear where a literal consists only of that punctuation (e.g. the T.join('和') separator and '（3）' counters); they are not CJK code points and do not affect the zero-CJK gate, but a few may look slightly Chinese-styled. (b) The topology subtitle composes array items via T.join('和') and cannot be reordered by literal substitution, so it remains partly awkward English.
Plurality of count fragments is static ('1 devices'); MT cannot inflect and literal substitution cannot branch on the number, so this is accepted rather than invented.
